gen-gf-sniglet-gf-cairo-play: Cairo Play reads openly, with round letters that stay clear even when the text shrinks. Sniglet is the louder partner, its line unmodulated and its terminals stopping short of a curl, so the two sit like a shout and a nod.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-cantarell: Sniglet leads with a level, unshaded line and terminals that stop before they curl back in. And Cantarell follows in a friendly sans, its c tips pulled apart and its arches matching the stems.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-carme: Terminals that stop short of curling back give Sniglet its distinctive look, drawn with no weight accents at all. Carme answers in thin sans-serif strands with open counters, so shrinking the heading would blur that gap quickly.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-catamaran: Bent-wire sign lettering is what defines Sniglet, its thickness constant while terminals stop short of curling. But Catamaran supplies loose, curvy sans-serif letters, and that unclamped looseness is the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-chakra-petch: Commanding in its plain, level strokes, Sniglet stops its terminals short of curling back in and shows no weight accents. Chakra Petch gives the sans a cupped, contemporary counterpart.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Chiron Hei HK reads with a wide-open c, like a bracelet pulled apart, and stays modern throughout. But Sniglet above it draws one plotter-pen line, so the sans looks lively against that single-weight heading.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-commissioner: Sniglet's terminals stop short of curling back in, and its line carries no weight accents whatsoever. Commissioner handles the reading, a plain sans with smooth curves that never clog, while Sniglet handles the attention.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-didact-gothic: Didact Gothic moves along without snagging on a closed-up bowl, each stroke carrying the same visual weight. And Sniglet above it is the showier voice, so a plain sans below that size works well.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-dotgothic16: Sniglet is distinctive and commanding, its terminals stopping short of curling back in, with a level, unaccented line. DotGothic16 sits beside it as a plain sans, tube-like and approachable.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-doto: Bent tubing with a bold, level look: that is Sniglet, with terminals that stop before curling. And Doto follows in sans-serif with wide margins around each glyph, so a long passage would feel spacious and easygoing.
